about_the_game: Get your first taste of Nighthawks, the vampire RPG. Experience your first night as a modern vampire in a city where your existence has been exposed. Meet the locals, start learning your way around and make a little trouble... but remember to be back home by sunrise.

content_descriptors.notes: Nighthawks features strong language and adult situations, with occasional moments of non-explicit nudity in romance scenes. Most mature content is only conveyed using text, with no graphic sex scenes or sexual violence.
